== frame after_compound cursor=3,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cd / && export TMP_COMPOUND=value; env | grep TMP_COMPOUND
|TMP_COMPOUND=value
|
|testuser@<HOST> / $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cd
@3 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 /
